parameters.content:
Single workflow, two waits (15min, 4h). Raw-body HMAC (not JSON.stringify).
Real consent check (opt_in AND NOT opt_out), not just phone-exists.
Coupon is only ever created in the SECOND-TOUCH branch — structurally
unreachable from first touch. Coupon is a REAL Shopify discount code (GraphQL discountCodeBasicCreate) 
not a random string. Every external call has retry +
error-output routed to a failure-recording node, never a silent stop.

Raw body HMAC verification, field validation, idempotency check —
all before the 15-minute wait and before anything is sent.

Order status re-checked against the live Shopify checkout (not the
stale webhook payload). Real consent check, not phone-exists.

Deterministic branch on payment_method (config-driven COD gateway
list, not hard-coded). Product image fetched from Shopify Admin API —
the checkout webhook payload does not include it.

parameters.content:
A Razorpay Payment Link is a generic payment collection — completing it
does NOT automatically create a order or mark the Shopify checkout
completed. Without this workflow, a customer who pays through the link
keeps getting the 4h coupon anyway, because WF-01's order-status checks
only ever look at Shopify, which never learns the payment happened.
This is the one genuinely required second workflow — not a pattern split.

nodes.name: WHY THIS SECOND WORKFLOW IS ACTUALLY NECESSARY2

parameters.jsCode:
const headerEventId = $('Razorpay Payment Webhook2').item.json.headers?.['x-razorpay-event-id'] || null;
return { json: { razorpay_event_id: headerEventId } };

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO cartrecovery.razorpay_webhook_events
    (event_id, event_type)
  VALUES ($1, $2)
  ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS inserted;

WITH lookup AS (
  SELECT
    ra.id,
    ra.status,
    c.checkout_token,
    c.line_items,
    c.currency,
    cu.email AS customer_email,
    cu.phone_e164 AS customer_phone
  FROM cartrecovery.recovery_attempts ra
  JOIN cartrecovery.carts c ON c.id = ra.cart_id
  JOIN cartrecovery.customers cu ON cu.id = ra.customer_id
  WHERE ra.id = $1
)
SELECT
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lookup) AS found,
  (SELECT id FROM lookup LIMIT 1) AS id,
  (SELECT status FROM lookup LIMIT 1) AS status,
  (SELECT checkout_token FROM lookup LIMIT 1) AS checkout_token,
  (SELECT line_items FROM lookup LIMIT 1) AS line_items,
  (SELECT currency FROM lookup LIMIT 1) AS currency,
  (SELECT customer_email FROM lookup LIMIT 1) AS customer_email,
  (SELECT customer_phone FROM lookup LIMIT 1) AS customer_phone;
UPDATE cartrecovery.razorpay_webhook_events SET event_type = event_type || ':unmatched_reference' WHERE event_id = $1;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE cartrecovery.payment_attempts
  SET status = 'paid',
      paid_at = now()
  WHERE recovery_attempt_id = $1
    AND provider_ref_id = $2
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated) AS updated,
  (SELECT id FROM updated LIMIT 1) AS payment_attempt_id;
UPDATE cartrecovery.recovery_attempts SET status = 'payment_attempt_mismatch', failure_reason = 'payment_attempt_mismatch_or_not_found', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1;
